description:
Welcome to The Den Nest!
===================
This is the leveling branch of our main guild! We hope to help newer players learn the game and continue to grow strong if that's what they want to do. If you're under level 70 Combat, this is a good place for you! 

We're a semi-casual guild of fellow lovers of progress bars and idle games. 

Apply here in-game and come say hello in our Discord!

Whoa adventurer, you look a little strong for this guild. Are you Combat level 60? You should check out The Den, our main guild. 

Recruitment Requirements
===================
- Enjoy the game at your pace.
- Contribute to the Challenges when you can, it helps the guild gain Marks which we need for Raids. 
- Please show some activity every week, whether it's a raid or item contribution to Challenges. 
- Minimum Total Level = 1
- Join our Discord to stay connected with the guild. https://discord.gg/GA5hkVVN9F

Guild Members
===========
- Communication - Please join our guild Discord and stay connected with your fellow guildies! 

- Raids - We run daily Raids at 6PM CST, please check the Guild page and/or Discord often for details. We've been running double raids each night, check locations!

- Activity - I ask that everyone maintain weekly activity, whether it's a raid or an item contribution. The more our members are participating, the more XP we can all gain. I will kick members who have shown zero activity for a week. 


FAQ/Info
=======
- Challenges

Completing Challenges is a way for the Guild to earn Marks. These are just item exchanges. The items needed are randomly selected by the game. I or a guild Officer can generate a new round of Challenges every 24h. We earn 1 Mark per item challenge we complete. At our current guild level, we can generate 6 Challenges each round. 

- Marks 

Marks are the guild currency that we can earn by completing the Challenges here in the Guild tab. Marks are used to schedule Raids, and create Announcements for the guild. 
- Guild Level

Self-explanatory, this is just the level of our Guild. As far as I can tell, higher levels unlock more member slots, access to higher level Raids, and more Challenges at a time.
- Guild Mastery

This is your own personal stat related to Guild participation. You earn XP here by contributing to Challenges, and joining Raids. 
- Raids

These are group battles that the entire Guild can join in on. As the guild levels up, we can clear higher level Raids. Each Raid is in a different map location, so keep an eye out on when/where Raids are happening. You will need to Travel to the zone in order to Join. Raids are a great way to earn some Gold, Combat XP, and Guild/Guild Mastery XP.
